T010 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (BasisObjects.Rn n)),
  dimH (F n E) = dimH E + 1 ∧ dimH E < ∞ ∧ dimH (F n E) < ∞ ∧ dimH E + 1 < ∞ →
    (Isometry (j n) ∧
        Function.Bijective (j n) ∧
          Function.LeftInverse (unj n) (j n) ∧
            Function.RightInverse (unj n) (j n) ∧
              j n '' BasisObjects.euclideanLift n '' F n E = G n E ∧
                ∀ (x y : Rn n) (t u : ℝ),
                  dist (j n (BasisObjects.euclideanLift n (x, t))) (j n (BasisObjects.euclideanLift n (y, u))) ^ 2 =
                      ∑ h, |x.ofLp h - y.ofLp h| ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2 ∧
                    dist (BasisObjects.euclideanLift n (x, t)) (BasisObjects.euclideanLift n (y, u)) ^ 2 =
                      ∑ h, |x.ofLp h - y.ofLp h| ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (BasisObjects.Rn n × ℝ)), dimH (BasisObjects.euclideanLift n '' S) = dimH S) →
        dimH (G n E) = dimH E + 1 ∧ dimH E < ∞ ∧ dimH (G n E) < ∞
'Translation.T010' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
